description:
The Great Plains Area Indian Health Service intends to issue a solicitation for fire alarm inspections and testing for multiple locations in North and South Dakota.


The anticipated solicitation date is March 19, 2026
 

The PSC is H963: Other qc/test/inspect- alarm, signal, and security detection systems
The NAICS is 561621: Security Systems Services which has a small business size standard of $25 million.
The proposed solicitation number is 75H70626Q00113 with an anticipated closing date of March 9, 2026.
This solicitation will be issued as a 100% Indian Small Business Economic Enterprise (ISBEE) Set- Aside.

Places of Performance:
